metadata.title: सरकारी नौकरी से गायब होता आदिवासी | Exclusion of Adivasis From Jobs | ST reservation
metadata.description: The Adivasi Adhikar Rashtriya Manch recently held a convention highlighting the theme of "Exclusion of Adivasis from Jobs." The report presented at the event alleged that the Modi government has systematically reduced job opportunities for tribals in government and public sector roles. Participants expressed deep concern over the ongoing violation of legal and constitutional rights of Adivasis, pointing to policies that undermine their access to employment and welfare. The convention also called for urgent measures to protect tribal rights, ensure fair representation in jobs, and address the broader socio-economic challenges faced by Adivasi communities across the country.
